en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a peaceful lakeside scene with several rowboats pulled up along a wooded shoreline. There is an island or peninsula covered in trees visible across the water. The card features printed text identifying the location as 'Tampere - Tammerfors' and publisher information. There is also handwritten text in what appears to be Finnish at the bottom.
